mapper.select: SELECT a.approval_id AS approvalId, a.operation_id AS operationId, a.state AS state, a.requirement AS requirement, a.argument_digest AS argumentDigest, a.target_resource AS targetResource, a.approver_scope AS approverScope, a.approver_id AS approverId, a.expires_at AS expiresAt, a.decided_at AS decidedAt, a.created_at AS createdAt, o.run_id AS runId, a.tenant_id AS tenantId FROM approval a JOIN tool_operation o ON o.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND o.operation_id = a.operation_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND a.approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE approval SET state = #{newState}::approval_state, approver_id = #{approverId}, decided_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid
